newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bawag says will not bid for CA.
newsitem.headline: Bawag says will not bid for CA.

text.p: Austria's Bank fuer Arbeit und Wirtschaft (Bawag) denied on Monday it was set to make an offer for sell-off candidate Creditanstalt (CA), countering growing speculation over the weekend, Austrian news agency APA said.
"We have not made an offer for Creditanstatlt and we will not make one," APA quoted a spokesman for Bawag, which is 45 percent owned by Germany's Bayerische Landesbank.
Daily Der Standard on Saturday said Bawag was poised to make a bid for Creditanstalt which would significantly top an existing offer by a group led by insurer EA-Generali.
The consortium has offered 720 to 730 schillings a share for about two thirds of the state's 70 percent voting stake in the flagship bank.
The consortium, which includes Germany's Commerzbank, savings bank Die Erste and Banca Commerciale Italiana was about to complete its due diligence study of Creditanstalt on Monday.
Firm offers for the government's 19.9 million voting shares in the bank have to be submitted by December 16. -- Knut Engelmann, Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
